::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Hyderabad firm founded July 2016 (IIT Hyderabad ecosystem). Its Koala NB-IoT SoC, built on a licensed CEVA Dragonfly platform with Cyient handling IC design and production, was announced in June 2021. Its 5G base-station radios are FPGA-based. The DLI project is a 5G NB-IoT SoC for terrestrial and satellite links.
:::

## What does this firm design?

NB-IoT and non-terrestrial-network (satellite) IoT SoCs, plus FPGA-based 5G RAN and satellite modem platforms.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 4/5:** NB-IoT and satellite-IoT modem SoCs plus 5G RAN platforms.
- **IP ownership 3/5:** Koala SoC built on a licensed CEVA Dragonfly platform, with Cyient handling IC design and production.
- **Design completeness 4/5:** Koala NB-IoT SoC announced in June 2021, with Cyient handling production.
- **Market readiness 3/5:** Koala announced as a product; its 5G radios are FPGA-based; the DLI SoC is still in development.
